title.zh: 细分是一种给予：把单位的细分算作只给不取的形成，脊柱的前提不添任何前提就带来每一分辨率下的静止，生起不息需要开放；不算入细分的见证都由它供给
title.en: Refinement gives: with the splitting of the unit counted as a formation that gives without taking, the spine's premises bring rest at every resolution with no premise added, and arising without end needs openness; the witnesses that leave it uncounted are fed by it

claim.zh: 让单位跨过第 t 步分为 split t + 1 个更细的单位：以更细的单位计，每个条件比此前多立 split t 乘其水平。把细分算作又一个形成（Flow.withRefinement、Web.withRefinement：它从不活跃，不要求、不汲取任何东西），它给每个条件 split t 乘其水平，什么也不取。于是在细分的单位下平衡（Flow.BalancesAt (split + 1)）恰是算入细分的流在脊柱意义下平衡（Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement）。细分只给不取：算入它的流在一个家族上耗散，恰当流自身的形成在其上耗散并且细分什么也不给该家族（Flow.withRefinement_dissipatesOn_iff）；算入它而一步被围住并被耗散时，细分在那一步什么也不给任何条件（Flow.refinement_gives_nothing）。所以，在有普查、关系项都体现、在细分的单位下平衡的世界中，算入细分后耗散并且从 T 起每步被围住时，生起与止息都不复现（World.rests_refinement_counted）；生起不息时，算入细分后没有一步开始每步被围住的一段（World.arising_opens_refinement_counted）。前提就是脊柱的前提，只是读入了细分：不添任何前提。不算入细分，同样的结论在细分什么也不给之处成立：耗散、从 T 起每步被围住而细分从 T 起不给任何关系项时，生起与止息都不复现（World.rests_unrefined，经 World.after 把世界从 T 起读，用脊柱的 World.rests_enclosed），生起不息需要开放或细分的给予（World.arising_needs_refinement）；从 T 起封闭、细分从 T 起不给该家族时取用停止（Flow.taking_needs_refinement）；储备在细分的单位下只下降而细分不给它时，就是脊柱的储备，不被支持的形成活跃的步不多于其储备（Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined）。见证：Emission、Alternation 与 Circulation 中，以及单位在任意晚的步细分时 Asymptote 中，细分在任意晚的步有所给予；Dwindle 中细分每步给予储备（refinement_feeds_witnesses）。它们的流在每个封闭家族上耗散，所以它们的生起、交换、取用与储备的延续都由细分供给。
claim.en: Let the unit split into split t + 1 finer units across the step from t: counted in the finer unit, each condition stands at split t times its level more than before. Count the refinement as one more formation (Flow.withRefinement, Web.withRefinement: never active, requiring and drawing on nothing), which gives each condition split t times its level and takes nothing. Then balance at the refining unit (Flow.BalancesAt (split + 1)) is exactly the spine's balance of the flow with the refinement counted (Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement). The refinement gives without taking: with it counted, the flow dissipates on a family exactly where its own formations do and the refinement gives the family nothing (Flow.withRefinement_dissipatesOn_iff); across a step enclosed and dissipated on with it counted, the refinement gives no condition anything (Flow.refinement_gives_nothing). So in a world with a census and embodied relata, balanced at the refining unit and, with the refinement counted, dissipative and enclosed at every step from T on, neither arising nor ceasing recurs (World.rests_refinement_counted); where arising recurs, no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed with the refinement counted (World.arising_opens_refinement_counted). The premises are the spine's, read with the refinement counted: none is added. Without counting it, the same holds wherever the refinement gives nothing: dissipative and enclosed at every step from T on, with the refinement giving no relatum anything from T on, neither arising nor ceasing recurs (World.rests_unrefined, reading the world from T on by World.after and using the spine's World.rests_enclosed), and arising without end needs openness or the refinement's giving (World.arising_needs_refinement); taking from a family closed from T on stops where the refinement gives it nothing from T on (Flow.taking_needs_refinement); a reserve that only falls in the refining unit, where the refinement gives it nothing, is the spine's reserve, an unsupported formation being active at most its reserve times (Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined). The witnesses: in Emission, Alternation and Circulation, and in Asymptote where the unit splits at arbitrarily late steps, the refinement gives at arbitrarily late steps, and in Dwindle it gives the reserve at every step (refinement_feeds_witnesses). Their flows dissipate on every closed family, so what keeps them arising, exchanging, taking or lasting is what the refinement gives.

hypotheses.zh: 分辨率：单位跨过每一步分为 split t + 1 个更细的单位，只细分不变粗；每一步的量仍是该步单位的自然数。这是定理的假设，不是公理。
hypotheses.en: Resolution: the unit splits into split t + 1 finer units across each step, refining and never coarsening; amounts at each step stay natural numbers of that step's unit. This is a hypothesis of the theorems, not an axiom.

hypotheses.zh: 算入细分：把细分读作一个给予的形成，是一种读法，不是定理。依据 Ren 2026-10-11：“A is right - because of change, there is difference, therefore there are difference in its possibility in its becoming … so in the sense of becoming, the becoming into will have relational difference, or it won't be "becoming"”。作者的读法（AI，待 Ren）：一个量是一个被做出的差异，更细的区分本身是一个生成，须有所给予。定理本身对两种读法都成立：Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement 是恒等，不算入细分的规律也一并陈述。
hypotheses.en: Counting the refinement: reading the refinement as a formation that gives is a reading, not a theorem. It follows Ren, 11 October 2026: ‘A is right - because of change, there is difference, therefore there are difference in its possibility in its becoming … so in the sense of becoming, the becoming into will have relational difference, or it won't be "becoming"’. The author's reading (AI, pending Ren): an amount is a difference made, so a finer distinction is itself a becoming that something must give. The theorems hold under either reading: Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement is an identity, and the laws without counting the refinement are stated too.

hypotheses.zh: 世界的前提：活动的普查、每个关系项都体现，与静止定理（continued-change-needs-openness）相同；算入细分后的耗散与被围住是脊柱的耗散与被围住，作用于算入细分的流。
hypotheses.en: The world premises: a census of activity and every relatum embodied, as in the rest theorem (continued-change-needs-openness); dissipation and enclosure with the refinement counted are the spine's dissipation and enclosure, applied to the flow with the refinement counted.

correspondence.zh: 单位固定时的静止定理（continued-change-needs-openness，World.rests_enclosed、World.arising_opens）是细分什么也不给的情形。rest-at-every-resolution 说明不算入细分时，单位的量子承载了静止：其余前提都满足而生起不息（Emission、Alternation）。本结果说明那些见证不是静止的反例，而是被围住而有源的世界：算入细分，细分只给不取，脊柱的耗散排除了这样的给予，所以不添前提，静止在每一分辨率下成立，“生起不息需要开放”在每一分辨率下成立。这回答 Ren 2026-10-11 的“for the case of 0, why can't we have it?”，作者读作零前提的情形（AI，待 Ren 确认）。内容是读法，不是新的动力学：被围住的世界中，凡有所立之处，算入细分的耗散与被围住排除细分本身；细分在围住之内是一个源。
correspondence.en: The rest theorem at a fixed unit (continued-change-needs-openness, World.rests_enclosed, World.arising_opens) is the case where the refinement gives nothing. rest-at-every-resolution shows that, without counting the refinement, the unit's quantum carries rest: every other premise holds while arising never ceases (Emission, Alternation). This result shows those witnesses are not counterexamples to rest but enclosed worlds with a source: counted, the refinement gives without taking, which the spine's dissipation excludes, so rest holds at every resolution with no premise added, and so does ‘arising without end needs openness’. This answers Ren's ‘for the case of 0, why can't we have it?’ of 11 October 2026, read by the author as the case of zero premises (AI, pending Ren's confirmation). The content is the reading, not new dynamics: in an enclosed world, wherever something stands, dissipation and enclosure with the refinement counted exclude the refinement itself; inside an enclosure the refinement is a source.

detail.zh: World.rests_unrefined 与 World.rests_refinement_counted 把世界从 T 起读（World.after），对它应用脊柱的静止定理 World.rests_enclosed；World.arising_opens 是细分什么也不给时的情形。
detail.en: World.rests_unrefined and World.rests_refinement_counted read the world from T on (World.after) and apply the spine's rest theorem World.rests_enclosed to it; World.arising_opens is the case where the refinement gives nothing.

output.zh: 有普查、关系项都体现、平衡、耗散且从某步起每步被围住的世界中，生起与止息都不复现。
output.en: In a world with a census, embodied relata, balanced, dissipative and enclosed at every step from some step on, neither arising nor ceasing recurs.

input.zh: 细分从 T 起不给任何关系项时，从 T 起读的世界平衡（World.after_balanced）、耗散、被围住，并有普查与体现。
input.en: Where the refinement gives no relatum anything from T on, the world read from T on is balanced (World.after_balanced), dissipative and enclosed, with a census and embodiment.

conditions.zh: 活动的普查；关系项都体现；在细分的单位下平衡；从 T 起耗散并被围住；细分从 T 起什么也不给。
conditions.en: A census of activity; embodied relata; balance at the refining unit; dissipative and enclosed from T on; the refinement giving nothing from T on.

detail.zh: 复用细分单位下的平衡（Flow.BalancesAt、Flow.BalancesAt.lowers）、量子的计数（losses_bound、bounded_not_recurring）、乘法的重组（add_mul_split）与见证（Emission、Alternation、Circulation、Asymptote、Dwindle 及其平衡、耗散、封闭与复现的定理）。
detail.en: Reuses balance at a refining unit (Flow.BalancesAt, Flow.BalancesAt.lowers), the counting of quanta (losses_bound, bounded_not_recurring), the regrouping of products (add_mul_split) and the witnesses (Emission, Alternation, Circulation, Asymptote, Dwindle and their theorems of balance, dissipation, closure and recurrence).

output.zh: 在细分的单位下平衡且被耗散时，家族的存量连同取用者不多于 r t 乘此前的存量；每步 q 乘余下的连同 k 个量子不多于 q 乘此前时，量子之和有界；见证在其单位下平衡、耗散，生起、交换或取用复现。
output.en: Balanced at a refining unit and dissipated on, the family's stock with its takers is within r t times the stock before; where each step q times what remains with k quanta is within q times what was there, the quanta are bounded; the witnesses balance at their units, dissipate, and arise, exchange or take at arbitrarily late steps.

input.zh: 细分什么也不给时，r t 乘存量就是存量，每个取用的步失去一个单位。
input.en: Where the refinement gives nothing, r t times the stock is the stock, and every taking step loses one unit.

conditions.zh: 在 split + 1 的单位下平衡；耗散；封闭的不重复家族。
conditions.en: Balance at the unit split + 1; dissipation; a closed family without repetition.

detail.zh: 统一计划 R4：表示的范围之一，量的单位，按 Ren 2026-10-11 的选择以零前提的形式陈述；这不是无公理的整体演绎。
detail.en: Unification plan R4: one dimension of the representation's scope, the unit of amounts, stated in its zero-premise form following Ren's choice of 11 October 2026; this is not the deduction of the whole without axioms.

detail.zh: 不算入细分时的边界：Emission 与 Alternation 有普查、关系项都体现、在减半的单位下平衡、耗散、每步被围住，生起不息（rest-at-every-resolution）；由本结果，细分在任意晚的步给予它们（refinement_feeds_witnesses），所以没有零前提的静止定理的反例。算入细分时它们在被围住之处不耗散：细分是一个源。
detail.en: The boundary without counting the refinement: Emission and Alternation have a census, embodied relata, balance at a halving unit, dissipation and every step enclosed, and arise without end (rest-at-every-resolution); by this result the refinement gives to them at arbitrarily late steps (refinement_feeds_witnesses), so neither is a counterexample to rest with the refinement counted. Counted, they do not dissipate where enclosed: the refinement is a source.

detail.zh: Asymptote 与 Circulation：封闭的池在任意晚的步被取用，细分在任意晚的步给予这个池（Flow.taking_needs_refinement、refinement_feeds_witnesses）；Dwindle：储备在更细单位下每步下降而永不到零，细分每步给予它（Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined、refinement_feeds_witnesses）。
detail.en: Asymptote and Circulation: the closed pool is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, and the refinement gives to it at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.taking_needs_refinement, refinement_feeds_witnesses); Dwindle: the reserve falls in the finer unit at each step without reaching zero, and the refinement gives to it at every step (Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined, refinement_feeds_witnesses).

limitations.zh: 离散步；单位只细分不变粗，量是细分后的有理数，不含实数量与连续时间；算入细分是一种读法（Ren 的方向，作者的展开待 Ren），不是推出的；算入细分的流以 Option 为形成，不是同一种关系项的世界，所以静止经从 T 起读的世界由脊柱的定理得出，而不是对算入细分的世界直接应用；“不复现”是复现的否定，不是某步之后不再发生；“the case of 0”指零前提，Ren 已确认；不添前提指不在脊柱的前提上添加，脊柱的耗散（Ren 读作熵的每次交换的最小损失）仍是脊柱的前提；不含伦理谓词；尚无独立审查。
limitations.en: Discrete steps; the unit refines and never coarsens, amounts being rationals by refinement, with neither real amounts nor continuous time; counting the refinement is a reading (Ren's direction, the author's elaboration pending Ren), not derived; the flow with the refinement counted has Option formations and is not a world of one kind of relatum, so rest follows from the spine's theorem through the world read from T on, not by applying it to a counted world directly; ‘does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing happens; ‘the case of 0’ means zero premises, as Ren confirmed; no premise added means none added to the spine's, whose dissipation (the least loss per exchange, which Ren reads as entropy) stays its premise; no ethical predicate; not yet independently reviewed.

next_delta.zh: 每次交换的最小损失（熵）能否推出而不作前提，无损的交换是否存在（另一会话）；把细分作为普查中的一个关系项，使算入细分的流本身是一个世界，静止定理直接适用；储备与细分作为同一流的读法；连续时间与实数量（外围）；独立审查。
next_delta.en: whether the least loss per exchange (entropy) can be derived rather than supplied, and whether lossless exchanges exist (a separate session); the refinement as a relatum in the census, so that the counted flow is itself a world and the rest theorem applies directly; the reserve and the refinement read as one flow; continuous time and real amounts (periphery); an independent review.
